variants.title: Долина — цілісний світ
variants.composition: Generate ONE landscape 16:9 image. A restrained high bird's-eye perspective, camera pitched around 54 degrees and far enough to see the surrounding valley, rather than only a level. Curving old road enters lower left past the bus shelter, passes the enclosed cottage orchard in middle left and the wire forest further back. The reed bridge crossing is middle right. Breached weir and former pond basin with two residual pools are upper right, geographically connected. Strong organic S-shaped journey through the scene. Frame the lower foreground with a close grove, keep the road and tiny level stones readable, distant wooded ridge closes the horizon. All five places are identifiable within a SINGLE continuous world, with varied scales and spacing.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: AI concept render for Quiet Camp's continuous 3D roadmap, not a native Unity capture.

ASSET RESTRICTION IS THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: build the picture solely from the actual project models shown in the five input reference images. Images 1–3 are asset contact sheets, not layouts: reproduce those recognizable object silhouettes, proportions and construction. Image 4 shows the current built house, damaged roof, simple well and fence. Image 5 shows the actual broken rural dam, service shed, narrow watercourse and residual pools. Images 4–5 are GEOMETRY REFERENCES ONLY: completely improve the terrain, planting, lighting and composition. Do not preserve their evenly scattered vegetation, flat land or pristine road. Do not use any objects or architectural designs from other games. The contact-sheet labels MUST NOT appear in the result.

Allowed asset families, all already in this project:
- M0186 branching broadleaf tree with multiple polygon crown masses; M0187 angular conifer; M0811 birch, M0816 fruit tree, M0818 meadow broadleaf with leafy crown, M1179 slim angular poplar, M1186 young angular willow. Choose a visually consistent crown treatment from these references, give all trees coherent scale and late-summer green palette, preserve each recognizable silhouette. Build dense, irregular forest GROUPS and orchard remnants; trunks remain distinct and grounded, no plants penetrating houses, decks or open water.
- M0755 grass tuft, M0756 large grass carpet, M0777 leafy ground cover, M0134 angular bush, M0987 cattail reed. Repeat these actual forms in broad, connected meadow patches and thick understorey rather than sparse evenly scattered dots. Vegetation covers most of the ground with intentional clear paths and focal clearings.
- M1167 modest flat-roofed open concrete village bus shelter with bench and the existing muted blue/yellow small mosaic panel; M1210 single-storey rectangular whitewashed Ukrainian cottage, blue-gray base, small windows and a pitched gray corrugated roof, with the actual collapsed roof corner from image 4; M1207 simple small roofed well; M1177 damaged wooden picket fence and M1199 simple matching gate. Cottage yard fully enclosed on an irregular perimeter with connected gates and a narrow worn approach.
- M1203 simple rural utility pole with two crossarms, visible sagging wire spans like image 4. Existing broken pole can lie in dry undergrowth. No lattice pylons.
- M1170 small breached rural concrete weir/dam: simple surviving pale concrete walls and buttresses on both sides of the gap as in image 5, integrated into an EARTHEN EMBANKMENT ACROSS A SHALLOW VALLEY. M1175 small rectangular flat-roofed hydro service shed. M0132 broken short concrete road bridge and M0133 simple abutment: ends are actually supported on opposite banks. M1178 narrow short wooden plank footbridge supported at both ends, connected to footpaths. M0503 angular bank rocks.
Existing level waystones are only five tiny pale roadside stones with a very restrained warm light. Keep them small and natural.

WORLD/DOCUMENT CONTRACT: five places in one uninterrupted fictional post-apocalyptic Ukrainian valley, traversed in this order: QC001 last bus stop -> QC002 surviving orchard around abandoned cottage -> QC003 forest along severed rural wires -> QC004 reed crossing with broken road bridge and nearby narrow footbridge -> QC005 quiet water at breached small pond dam and derelict service shed. The route is a visual story told through actual structures and nature reclaiming them, without captions or story menus. Buildings have weathered, simple low-poly surfaces; use damage already present in reference geometry, no invented dramatic architecture, monuments or military assets.
Model NEW COMPOSITION THROUGH LANDSCAPE ONLY: connected rolling slopes, shallow gullies, creek bed, believable embankments, eroded banks and a sunken former pond bowl. Above the breached dam show exposed old pond-bed terraces covered in young willows and grass, two small residual pools and a narrow creek through the breach. No large impounded reservoir behind a breached dam, no enormous hydroelectric megadam, no impossible waterfall. Narrow old village asphalt follows natural terrain bends with broken uneven edges, faded fragmentary center marks, cracks and grass at shoulders; becomes worn dirt road and footpath. No perfect highway, no neat tan rectangular pads.
One late-summer day: warm side sunlight, bright cool soft shadows, visible grounding/contact shadows, layered depth with foreground foliage, middle-ground landmarks, distant forested slopes and only subtle valley haze. Cozy and quietly melancholic, long after abandonment, beautiful and alive.
STYLE: a polished restrained low-poly 3D GAME WORLD rendered with the actual asset shapes, coherent olive and meadow greens, weathered ivory/gray concrete, muted blue-gray water and roofs, warm dry earth. Clean readable volumetric forms, slightly faceted models, smooth terrain lighting. Not photorealistic, not painterly illustration, not a giant miniature island with cut edges. Rich vegetation through careful reuse and composition, not invented high-detail meshes. Preserve visibility of important road bends and landmarks from a bird's-eye camera.
NO tents, camping equipment, campsite grids, people, characters, vehicles, flags, readable text, labels, level numbers, floating platforms, story UI, ornate wells, castles, decorative houses or tropical plants. No depth-of-field or motion blur.
Only UI permitted: ONE very small unobtrusive ivory circular exit chevron in the top-left corner, no text, no border or phone mockup.

COMPOSITION FOR THIS VARIANT:
Generate ONE landscape 16:9 image. A restrained high bird's-eye perspective, camera pitched around 54 degrees and far enough to see the surrounding valley, rather than only a level. Curving old road enters lower left past the bus shelter, passes the enclosed cottage orchard in middle left and the wire forest further back. The reed bridge crossing is middle right. Breached weir and former pond basin with two residual pools are upper right, geographically connected. Strong organic S-shaped journey through the scene. Frame the lower foreground with a close grove, keep the road and tiny level stones readable, distant wooded ridge closes the horizon. All five places are identifiable within a SINGLE continuous world, with varied scales and spacing.

variants.title: Дорога крізь заросле село
variants.composition: Generate ONE portrait 9:16 image, intended as a mobile roadmap composition. High bird's-eye perspective pitched about 55 degrees, medium-far overview. Look along the journey: modest mosaic bus shelter at a worn bend in the bottom third, road climbs diagonally through thick grass to the fenced cottage and orchard in the middle third, then narrows under a broken rural pole line. In upper third reveal the reed crossing, small damaged weir and a sunken willow-covered pond basin. The woods are dense connected masses at frame edges with clear organic pockets around landmarks. Both sides have visible sloping land, not a vertical road strip with uniformly spaced trees. All five places belong to this coherent continuous geographic world. More intimate village view, same models, time of day and art treatment as the valley.

variants.title: Осушений ставок і переправа
variants.composition: Generate ONE landscape 16:9 image from a different HIGH BIRD'S-EYE angle across the water valley, approximately 55-degree pitch, pulled back to show the land. Focus on the existing small damaged weir integrated across an earthen embankment at lower right, the creek running through its breach, the ruined flat-roofed service shed beside it, the clearly sunken old pond bed with two residual pools and dense young willow patches in middle ground. Show the short broken road bridge with supported bank ends and a nearby NARROW short plank footbridge in lower-middle left. Worn approaches climb naturally up the banks to the cottage orchard and mosaic bus stop at the far left background, with the rural pole/wire route connecting the forest. Strong readable difference between dry old basin, wet creek, old banks and wooded hills. Do not invent complex dam machinery or a new dam design. Same five location assets, no new types of props. This is still one continuous five-stop roadmap, now revealing its hydrological story.
